help.title: Help
help.body:
## Using the replay

- **Play and pause** start and stop the replay. It starts on its own.
- **Speed** slows the replay down or speeds it up. Slower is easier to follow.
- **Previous step and Next step** move one message at a time.
- **The bar** lets you jump to any point.
- **Click a step** in the list to read its exact message.

## Language

Use the language buttons at the top to switch between English and Czech. Your choice is remembered in your browser. Articles that are not translated yet are shown in English.

## Good to know

Watching a replay does not call any AI service, so it is free. Running your own experiment uses your own Anthropic key and costs money at Anthropic. Agent Atlas remembers your language, settings and runs only in this browser, and your key only if you choose to, encrypted with a password that cannot be recovered.
about.title: About Agent Atlas
about.body:
Agent Atlas is an educational project that helps to understand how AI agents work, communicate and are orchestrated.

## Educational use only

Agent Atlas is a learning tool. It is not meant for real work.

## Licences

- The code is open source under the MIT licence.
- The site text, articles and translations are under CC BY 4.0.
- The name and logo of Agent Atlas are not licensed for reuse.

## Legal

Read the [privacy policy](#/page/privacy), the [terms of use](#/page/terms) and the [imprint](#/page/imprint).

create.taskLabel: 1. Describe the task for the agents
create.patternHelp: The orchestration pattern decides how the agents work together: who works when and who sees what. It also decides which connections the diagram allows. Changing it clears the diagram.
create.pattern.sequential: One after another, each passes its result on.
create.pattern.parallel: Several work at the same time, one combines the results, and more agents may follow to review or polish.
create.pattern.supervisor: A supervisor hands out work and decides when it is done.
create.pattern.debate: Debaters argue in rounds, a judge decides.
create.patternChanged: The diagram was cleared because the orchestration pattern changed.
